documentation.title: AIEPlace Configuration Options
documentation.description: This JSON file contains the default configuration parameters for running the AIEPlace placement algorithm. It includes options for method selection, input file paths, and hyperparameters for the algorithm.
documentation.author: Mark Sears
documentation.input.benchmark: Path to the benchmark file for placement.
documentation.input.xclbin: Path to the XCLBIN file for hardware acceleration.
documentation.params.partials_compute_method: choose: aie, cpu, simple, hybrid, threaded

params.comment_convergence: Convergence criteria (adaptive algorithm will stop early if met)
